title: Why we started BAMBU Interiors
summary: A London interiors business built around a direct relationship between the client, designer and delivery team.
sections: The most useful time to meet a contractor can be before a lease is agreed. Access hours, existing services and the landlord’s approval process can all change what a floor will cost to fit out. We started BAMBU to bring those questions into the first conversation.

We work with occupiers considering a move, landlords preparing a floor for letting and operators testing a flexible workspace. Each starts with a different question. A tenant may need somewhere for confidential calls. An operator needs to know how much of the floor can earn its keep.
A plan, a location and a rough date are enough to begin. We can identify which assumptions need testing before anyone commits to a specification.

title: How to read a test fit before signing a lease
summary: Look beyond the desk count. Trace three journeys through the proposed workplace.
sections: Follow the route from the lift to reception and the meeting room. Check what a visitor can see and whether anyone has to interrupt the working floor to show them through.
Picture colleagues arriving together, calls starting and a meeting breaking for lunch. A drawing can show enough chairs while leaving too little space to pull them out or pass behind them.

A test fit records assumptions. Ask which dimensions have been surveyed, which services information is current and which items still need specialist review. Keep those questions with the plan when comparing buildings.

title: Three questions to ask of a material sample
summary: A finish earns its place through installation, cleaning and repair as well as appearance.
sections: Take the sample to site and look at it beside a retained finish, in daylight and under the proposed lighting. Review a larger piece where grain or pattern varies.
Check the substrate, joints, edge details and installation sequence with the specialist. An attractive sample alone tells you little about the finished junction at a door.
Find out how the facilities team would clean it, replace a damaged section and obtain a matching spare. Record the product reference and maintenance instructions at handover.
